title: [Audit] Failed sign-ins and denied access
description: Every failed sign-in and every request refused or failed after sign-in, newest first. Read Action: authentication_failed, realm_authentication_failed and anonymous_access_denied are failed sign-ins (someone who could not prove who they are); access_denied is an authenticated identity hitting a permission wall; any other action failed outright. An Identity that reads as an opaque id is a principal whose events carry no email and no key name — usually an organisation-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its id.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_failed","realm_authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.event.action, attributes.authentication.type, client.geo.country_iso_code, client.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, attributes.event.action AS Action, attributes.authentication.type AS Credential, client.geo.country_iso_code AS Country, client.ip AS `Client IP`
